Ro.bar_b_note: The panel style is close to the deep blue-grey direction, but the murky, near-black rainy world behind it has no light, sky or depth and the panel has no teal or gold accents, so it does not read as Palworld-class finish.

Px.bar_b_note: A is a smooth clay-toy boar far below the naturalistic style bar and B's furred boar is closer but floats in its faint frames, and neither stands taller than the trainer.

So.bar_b_note: Side A's wolf matches the owner style bar, but side B loses its fur material in both faint frames (white with black blobs), which breaks the finish outright.

Ho.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing stylised elder with an earthy Meadows palette and readable face, at the finish of Palworld's human characters, though his cartoon face sits apart from the naturalistic creatures.

Ar.bar_b_note: A furred wolf with lightning streaks, at style-bar quality, large against the trainer, with grounded faint poses that read without a label; the neutral stage is the only thing holding it back.

top_changes.change: Fix the material that drops out on the So side-B wolf in its faint frames (white with black blobs) so the fur shader holds through every pose.

Craft panel: keep side A's text scale but show the full recipe list without truncating it, and replace the small keycap hints with high-contrast teal controller-glyph prompts (A Craft / B Leave), with gold for progress.
Replace the Px clay boar with the naturalistic furred boar, scale it clearly taller than the 1.80 m trainer and keep its faint-mid and faint-end bodies on the stage.
